name: Find Ay Mi Gatito Tower 🐱
desc:
Welcome to Make Your Outfit Tower! 💖

Choose a door and create your dream outfit!
Will you glow up… or get trolled?

Every choice gives you new items:
💄 hair, outfits, accessories
💀 or something that will DESTROY your look

⚠️ WARNING: some doors will TROLL you ⚠️
Reach the end and prove you’ve got the best outfit 💅

💗 Like the game + join the group for extra perks
